physicalProperties.Name: Aluminum 6061-T6
physicalProperties.Uses: The general-purpose structural aluminum: frames, brackets, enclosures, tooling plate.
physicalProperties.Watch: Welding softens the heat-affected zone. Not for >150 C. Lower strength than 7075.

Evidence.Condition: 6061-T6/T651 typical values. Conductivity at 20 °C; expansion averaged 20–100 °C; specific heat at 100 °C. E rounded from 10 Mpsi to 68.9 GPa. Poisson ratio and service limit remain estimates.
Evidence.CheckedProperties: Density, E (unit conversion), yield, tensile, conductivity, expansion, specific heat

physicalProperties.Name: Carbon Steel (1045)
physicalProperties.Uses: Shafts, gears, pins, axles; can be hardened by heat treatment.
physicalProperties.Watch: Rusts. Welding needs preheat; distortion during hardening.

Evidence.Condition: Generic reference estimates near room temperature; actual grade, temper, section, process and temperature can change properties. Service temperature and qualitative ratings are approximate.
